title: Rust Ownership as Linear Types
root_cause: C/C++ memory unsafety (use-after-free, double-free) stems from unrestricted aliasing. Rust borrow checker enforces linear/affine types at compile time.
resolution_type: Ownership: each value has exactly one owner. Borrowing: immutable xor mutable references. Lifetime analysis prevents dangling pointers. Zero-cost at runtime.
